goals: Greet people and answer 'How are you?' naturally ('Good, thanks. And you?') instead of the textbook 'I'm fine, thank you, and you?'
Introduce herself in 4 short sentences: name, where she's from, where she lives, what she does.
Use the verb 'be' (I'm / you're / he's / she's) in introductions without dropping it.
Say clear final consonants in name, meet, work and live, and ask for repetition or spelling when she doesn't understand.

medium: Do you have an English name?
hard: How do people in Taiwan usually greet each other?
What do you say when you meet someone for the first time?
Tell me three things about yourself.

key_phrases.en: Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you, too.
key_phrases.zh: 很高興認識你。／我也很高興認識你。

key_phrases.en: How are you? — Good, thanks. And you?
Sorry, can you say that again?
key_phrases.zh: 不好意思，可以再說一次嗎？

grammar.point_en: The verb BE: I am / you are / he is / she is
grammar.explain_zh: 中文常說「我很好」「我台灣人」，不一定需要「是」。但英文句子一定要有動詞，介紹名字、國家、職業、心情時都要用 be 動詞。I 用 am，you 用 are，he／she 用 is。口語常縮寫成 I'm、you're、he's、she's。

common_mistake.wrong: I very happy to meet you.
common_mistake.right: I'm very happy to meet you.
common_mistake.why_zh: 中文「我很高興」沒有「是」，但英文要加 am：I'm happy。

sound_focus.sentence: My last name is Lin, and I live and work in Tainan.

mini_lesson: Step 1 (5 min): Greet her three ways (Hi! / Good morning! / How are you?). Teach 'Good, thanks. And you?' as the natural answer and practice it until it comes out fast, without 'I'm fine, thank you, and you?'.

Step 2 (8 min): Go through the key phrases. Say each one twice, she repeats. Then run a quick question chain: What's your name? → Where are you from? → Where do you live? → What do you do? Repeat until she answers without notes.

Step 3 (7 min): Grammar — the be verb. Write 'I ___ from Taiwan. / She ___ a nurse. / You ___ late!' and have her fill in am / is / are. Point out that Chinese drops 是 in 我很好, but English needs I'm good.

Step 4 (5 min): Sound focus — final consonants. Say name, nice, meet, work, live, last; she repeats with a clear ending (lips closed on the m in name, no 'uh' after work). Then the practice sentence: slow, then normal speed.

Step 5 (5 min): Spelling game. Practice the alphabet sounds she mixes up (e.g. E/I, G/J). You say a Taiwanese city, she asks 'How do you spell that?' and writes what you spell; then switch roles with her own name.

roleplays.title: Meeting someone at a party
roleplays.setup_zh: 你在朋友的聚會上認識一位新朋友。跟他打招呼，並用簡單的句子介紹自己。
roleplays.teacher_role: Mark, a friendly guest at the party
roleplays.student_role: Herself, meeting Mark for the first time

lines.en: Hi! I'm Mark. What's your name?
Hi, Mark. I'm ___. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you, too. How are you?
Good, thanks. And you?
I'm great, thanks. Where are you from?
I'm from Taiwan. I live in ___.
Oh, nice! What do you do?
I'm a ___. I work at ___.
That's interesting. Well, I need a drink. See you later!
See you later, Mark!

roleplays.title: Chatting with a traveler in a café
roleplays.setup_zh: 你在咖啡店遇到一位來台灣旅行的外國人，她主動跟你聊天。介紹自己、問她問題；聽不懂時，請她再說一次。
roleplays.teacher_role: Sarah, a tourist from Canada visiting Taiwan
roleplays.student_role: Herself, a local sitting at the next table

lines.en: Hi there! Good morning. I'm Sarah.
Good morning, Sarah. I'm ___. Nice to meet you.
lines.zh: 早安，Sarah。我是___。很高興認識你。

lines.en: Nice to meet you, too. Sorry, how do you spell your name?
Thanks! So, are you from around here?
Yes, I'm from Taiwan. I live in ___. Where are you from?
lines.zh: 對，我是台灣人，住在___。你是哪裡人？

lines.en: I'm from Vancouver, in Canada. I'm here on vacation for two weeks.
Sorry, can you say that again?
lines.zh: 不好意思，可以再說一次嗎？

lines.en: Sure. I'm on vacation. Two weeks. So, what do you do?
I'm a ___. I work at ___. And you?
I'm a nurse. Well, I have to go. It was nice talking to you!
You too, Sarah! Goodbye. Have a nice trip!

teacher_twists: Say line 7 fast and naturally, so she has to use 'Sorry, can you say that again?' for real.
Spell her name back wrong on purpose ('M-A-Y?') so she must correct you: 'No, it's M-E-I.'
Add a surprise question, like 'Do you have an English name?' or 'Is Pingtung far from here?', and see if she answers with a short full sentence.

homework_zh: 用英文寫 4 句自我介紹（名字、來自哪裡、住在哪裡、做什麼工作），大聲唸 3 次並錄音傳給老師。
每天用 Anki 複習 Unit 1 卡片，注意 name、meet、work、live 的結尾音要清楚，後面不要加「ㄜ」。
練習用英文字母拼出自己的名字和住的城市，例如 P-I-N-G-T-U-N-G。
